title: run_command tests fail on Windows due to CWD corruption by spec integration tests
description: Two run_command tests (run_command_nonzero_exit_is_not_rust_error, run_command_stderr_captured) panic with Windows OS error 267 because std::env::current_dir() returns an invalid directory after spec integration tests mutate and delete the CWD via tempdir. Causes all-tests-pass and no-test-regression to fail on every Windows run regardless of what changed.
proposed_resolution: Fix run_command tests to supply an explicit working directory (e.g. tempdir) instead of relying on std::env::current_dir(); apply the CWD_LOCK pattern already used by spec integration tests.
